findings.title: The chat timeline receives raw delegated Network save arguments before dispatcher normalization
findings.evidence: src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts:256-268 copies tool_delegated inner.arguments directly into upsertToolPart. The SW sanitizes only later at src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts:706-718. The data_patterns row uses an expanded key-value args view (src/features/chat/tool-display/registry.tsx:1286-1299), and ConfigurableToolRow.tsx:110-120,188-205 offers copy and expansion of entry.args. On conversation load, src/lib/supabase/queries.ts:528-545 similarly hydrates block.arguments directly into tool args. Thus a synthetic access_token in an agent-authored Network save can remain visible/copyable in the timeline even after its execution receipt and pattern are clean.
findings.required: Apply the shared Network save normalization at the stream-to-chat and conversation-hydration consumer boundaries before upsert/render/copy, while preserving the raw wire arguments only for actual execution. Add a forcing test that sends a credential-bearing tool_delegated event through the real chat event handler, then checks the rendered/copyable arguments; cover hydrated conversation arguments separately.

prior_findings_rechecked: D48-ROOT-1: WebMCP now normalizes before schema parsing, confirmation persistence, receipts, and handler execution (dispatch.ts:1400-1475).
D48-ROOT-2: valid explicit domain survives normalization and reaches data_patterns save (network-urls.ts:153-170; data-patterns.ts:213-235).
D48-ROOT-3: manual Tools run now normalizes before validation and timeline broadcast (ToolsView.tsx:363-383).
positive: The Network UI masks recognized query values, permits explicit unknown-key classification, and passes that choice into saved matching.
savePattern normalizes Network name/config at the database insert boundary; ordinary date/page query values and valid explicit destinations are preserved.
Replay masks credential values for cross-run matching and keeps a transient in-window discriminator so differing credential values report ambiguity.
Native message and stream diagnostic changes omit raw capture/delegation payloads while retaining event metadata.
test_assessment: Existing D48 UI, sink, dispatcher, native, and stream tests exercise real extension seams with synthetic canaries; the dispatcher test does not exercise the independent stream-to-chat timeline consumer or hydrated conversation rendering. Manual Tools boundary test and build/live proof were pending at this source review. No runtime commands were run by this peer.
limits: No installed-extension or real-data verification was performed; live verdict stays UNVERIFIED.

The client source selects chat.tool_call.arguments and hydrates assistant block.arguments, but this review did not inspect the server write path or assert a server storage defect. Extension-only normalization cannot establish a server-side persistence guarantee.
Unknown credential query names need explicit user classification; the finite built-in key matcher cannot recognize every possible credential name.
